steps.title: Prepare phage stock sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of 0.22 µm‑filtered phage stock (≥10⁸ PFU/mL) stored at 4 °C into a closed screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Phenol:chloroform:isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), mix by gentle inversion (no vortex), centrifuge at room temperature for 10 min at 10,000 × g (9,500 RPM), and transfer the top aqueous layer to a new tube using chloroform‑compatible plastic (e.g., Eppendorf).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge RT 10 min at 10,000 × g (9,500 RPM).
Pipette off the top aqueous layer into a new tube using chloroform‑compatible plastic.

steps.title: Chloroform:isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), mix by gentle inversion (no vortex), centrifuge at room temperature for 10 min at 10,000 × g (9,500 RPM), and transfer the top aqueous layer to a new tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge RT 10 min at 10,000 × g (9,500 RPM).
Pipette off the top aqueous layer into a new tube.

steps.title: Optional DNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNase I 10X buffer and 1 µL DNase I (1 U/µL) to the aqueous phase (optional: add 1 µL RNase at 10 mg/mL), flick the tube, and incubate for 1 h 30 min at 37 °C in a water bath.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 1 h 30 min at 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: EDTA chelation of DNase
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of 0.5 M EDTA, pH 8.0, flick the tube, and incubate for 15 min at 75 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Proteinase K and SDS lysis
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and 50 µL 10 % SDS, flick the tube, and incubate overnight (~24 h) without shaking.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (e.g., 100 µL for a 1 mL sample) and flick to mix.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 × the sample volume of 100 % ethanol (e.g., 2.75 mL for a 1 mL sample), invert gently (no vortex), incubate at –20 °C for 30 min, centrifuge at room temperature for 10 min at 4,668 × g (5,000 RPM), discard the supernatant and retain the white pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge RT 10 min at 4,668 × g (5,000 RPM).

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Rinse the pellet with 50–100 µL 70 % ethanol, pipette‑mix (do not vortex), then dry the pellet on a heat block at 50–60 °C (optional fume hood) without exceeding 70 °C.

substeps.instruction: Dry pellet on heat block at 50–60 °C (optional fume hood).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA for quantification
steps.instruction: Ensure all ethanol is evaporated, add 32 µL Milli‑Q (or ultrapure DNase/RNase‑free) water, pipette‑mix to dissolve the pellet (do not vortex), and proceed to DNA quantification (e.g., Nanodrop).

substeps.instruction: Add 32 µL Milli‑Q (or ultrapure DNase/RNase‑free) water.
Pipette‑mix to dissolve pellet; do not vortex.
